Gainsborough's House, Sudbury (house-museum at his childhood home)
Back in Sudbury painting portraits; then moved to Ipswich (1752)
Moved to Bath (17 The Circus); studied van Dyck, built a fashionable portrait practice
Founding member of the Royal Academy
Moved to Schomberg House, Pall Mall, London
Painted King George III and Queen Charlotte; further royal commissions
Key works: The Blue Boy; Mr and Mrs Andrews; Mrs Mary Graham; The Painter's Daughters; The Morning Walk; Cottage Girl with Dog and Pitcher
Died in London; buried at St Anne's Church, Kew
